subject: Gate results for arms P (byte-identical replicate of arm K) and Q (top_k -1). The predeclared falsifier for arm K FIRED.
THE_HEADLINE: Arm P is a BYTE-IDENTICAL replicate of arm K and it returned 28 levels where arm K returned 44. The predeclared falsifier said verbatim: 'If it returns at or below 35, arm K's 44 was substantially luck.' It returned 28. **Arm K's 44 was substantially luck, and its promotion this morning is RETRACTED.**

arm_Q_top_k_unclamped.status: INCONCLUSIVE, ties go to the incumbent
arm_Q_top_k_unclamped.reading: 36 levels lands exactly on the pooled top_k-100 mean of 36.0, so -1 and 100 are indistinguishable. My predeclared prediction was 'I expect 36 to 44, because top_p = 0.95 probably already truncates below 100 candidates on most steps, which would make 100 and -1 nearly the same sampler.' It returned exactly 36. That prediction is CONFIRMED.

pooled_verdict_on_top_k.consequence: THE ENTIRE SAMPLING AXIS IS NOW CLOSED AS A TIE. Temperature: 0.3 -> 22, 0.6 -> 33 and 29, 0.9 -> 35, 1.2 -> 31. top_k: 20 -> 32.3 pooled, 100 -> 36.0 pooled, -1 -> 36. Every point is inside the noise except temperature 0.3, which is clearly bad. Ship temperature 0.9 with top_k 20 and stop spending commits here.

THE_INSTRUMENT_IS_FAR_WORSE_THAN_WE_MEAS.previous_estimate: sigma of one run's 25-game level total 3.6 to 4.3, arm-minus-control difference 5.1 to 6.1, 80%-power MDE about 12.6 levels. That rested on ONE pair (33 vs 29, a 4-level swing).
THE_INSTRUMENT_IS_FAR_WORSE_THAN_WE_MEAS.caveat: This rests on TWO pairs (swings of 4 and 16), so the estimate itself is barely identified. But the DIRECTION is unambiguous and the 4-level swing was the optimistic one.
THE_INSTRUMENT_IS_FAR_WORSE_THAN_WE_MEAS.what_it_means: A single 25-game ordinary commit may be close to worthless for anything short of a structural change. Every promote/reject on record, including today's, is weaker than its write-up claims.
THE_INSTRUMENT_IS_FAR_WORSE_THAN_WE_MEAS.the_fix: solution/kaggle/generated/re-arc-3-verification-2026-08-24.json. A 190-game offline suite (MIT, verified today) cuts sigma by about 2.8x for zero Kaggle GPU and zero submission slots. This is now the highest-priority work item, ahead of any capability arm.

decision.arm_K_shipping_status: RETRACTED. The submission kit reverts to arm H (temperature 0.9, top_k 20), the config whose first board draw scored 2.63.
decision.why_arm_H_and_not_arm_K: Under the 2026-08-24 amendment a tie goes to the incumbent, and pooled top_k-100 (36.0) against the control family (32.3) is a tie. Arm H additionally has a real board draw of 2.63 while arm K has none, and the variance research established that CONCENTRATING draws on one config beats rotating (rotation is worth -0.01 to -0.07).
decision.what_is_NOT_claimed: That top_k is harmful. Pooled it is +3.7 levels, leaning positive but well inside noise. It is unproven, not refuted.
decision.process_note: I promoted arm K this morning on n=1 and said so in the record at the time ('n = 1', 'a confirmation run is already pushed'). The confirmation is why we know. The submission it produced cost nothing, because the board keeps our maximum and the 2.63 draw was arm H's.
